test_to_numpy_default: test the to_numpy method on a Float64 array converting to default object or float64 dtype
test_to_numpy_float_dtype: test converting a Float64 array to float64 dtype with NA values replaced by np.nan
test_to_numpy_int_dtype: test converting a Float64 array to int64 dtype, raising ValueError when NA values are present
test_to_numpy_na_value: test the na_value parameter in to_numpy to fill NA values with custom values like None, False, or -99
test_to_numpy_copy_behavior: test the copy parameter in to_numpy to control zero-copy vs copy behavior on Float64 arrays
test_to_numpy_readonly: test to_numpy behavior on a readonly FloatingArray preserving writeable flags appropriately
test_to_numpy_various_dtypes: test converting a Float64 array to multiple dtypes including float64, float32, int32, int64, and bool
test_to_numpy_na_raises_incompatible_dty: test that to_numpy raises ValueError when converting Float64 with NA to incompatible dtypes like int64 or bool
test_to_numpy_string_dtype: test converting a Float64 array with NA values to string dtype
